Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a flood damage relief program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing assistance for flood damage; adding anew section to chapter 43.31 RCW; creating a new section; and making anappropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that citizens andbusinesses are experiencing extensive damage from winter floods. Thelegislature further finds that federal disaster assistance programs andother forms of disaster relief are not always available to assist thosein need. Therefore, the legislature finds that a state program forflood damage assistance and relief must be created to help Washingtoncitizens and communities to protect their homes, businesses, andcommunities.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.31 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of community, trade, and economic development shallestablish a flood damage relief program to provide financial assistanceto individuals, businesses, and local governments that have experienced p. 1 HB 3169flood damage. The department shall establish criteria for awardinggrants for emergency repair and cleanup activities as a result of flooddamage. The criteria must include, but is not limited to: (1) The availability of other sources of financial assistanceincluding other state or federal disaster assistance; (2) The extent of the damage; (3) Matching funds that may be available; and (4) The financial need of the applicant.

The sum of five million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year endingJune 30, 2007, from the general fund to the department of community,trade, and economic development for the purposes of this act.
